lessons_learned: Lesson learned: Gating the StudentTeamDetail 'open-title-workspace-btn' CTA inside (!project?.defenseSchedule?.status || status === 'none') hides workspace navigation once a hearing is scheduled; also, 4-column desktop gate grids (lg:grid-cols-4 with truncate) clip Capstone gate labels inside max-w-5xl containers.

Prevention runbook/checklist: Keep team-to-workspace CTAs independent of defenseSchedule.status for locked teams, use balanced sm:grid-cols-2 layouts with wrapping labels for status checklists, and avoid redundant page.goto reloads in Playwright scripts against Docker Vite by using visible SPA links and in-place viewport toggles.
